scope: Standing Hellenic Parliament in the former royal palace, including its exterior, roof voids and three entrance porticos.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Official Parliament history identifies Gärtner’s three-storey exterior wings, two storeys in the original middle wing, the original courts, east and west porticos and the six-column northern portico created for Parliament.
City guide distinguishes the standing Parliament from its Syntagma Square forecourt and the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.
